controlMatrix.disclaimer: VibeDoctor DPDP output is a technical readiness / engineering-risk assessment. It is not legal advice and not a DPDP compliance certification.

controls.title: Personal data processing inventory from code
controls.explanation: Observed 36 personal-data inventory signal(s).
limitations: Cannot prove absence of personal data outside scanned paths

controls.title: Applicability determination requires organisational context
controls.explanation: Is the organisation a Data Fiduciary under DPDP for this processing?
limitations: Legal applicability is not a code property
controls.remediation: Record organisation context in .vibedoctor/dpdp/context.yml and obtain legal review where needed.
controls.humanReviewQuestion: Is the organisation a Data Fiduciary under DPDP for this processing?

controls.title: Notice presentation technical signal
controls.explanation: No privacy notice / notice_version technical signals observed.
limitations: Notice adequacy and language quality require human review
controls.remediation: Implement notice delivery at collection points with version tracking.

controls.title: Consent capture implementation
controls.explanation: Consent capture signals found; legal adequacy of consent requires human review.
limitations: Cannot verify free, specific, informed, unconditional consent quality
controls.remediation: Implement explicit consent capture with purpose binding before processing.
controls.humanReviewQuestion: Is consent free, specific, informed, unconditional and unambiguous?

controls.title: Consent metadata completeness
controls.explanation: Consent metadata incomplete (timestamp=false, purpose=true, notice=false).
limitations: Schema signals may not reflect runtime consent manager behaviour
controls.remediation: Store consent_given_at, purpose_id, and notice_version with each consent record.
controls.humanReviewQuestion: Who is the system of record for consent proofs?

controls.title: Consent withdrawal path
controls.explanation: Withdrawal signals observed; ease-of-use and processor propagation need human review.
limitations: Ease of withdrawal relative to grant requires UX review
controls.remediation: Provide a withdrawal API/UI that is as easy as giving consent and propagates to processors.
controls.humanReviewQuestion: Can a Data Principal withdraw consent as easily as they gave it?

controls.title: Purpose identifier technical binding
controls.explanation: No purpose identifier binding signals observed.
limitations: Secondary use policies cannot be fully validated statically
controls.remediation: Tag processing pipelines and consent with purpose identifiers and enforce purpose checks.

controls.title: API over-fetching of personal data objects
controls.explanation: No API over-fetch patterns observed.
limitations: Cannot prove field necessity for every business case
controls.remediation: Return DTOs with explicit field selection rather than whole entities.

controls.title: Broad database selection of personal records
controls.explanation: No broad personal-data select patterns observed.
limitations: Some admin tooling legitimately needs broad reads
controls.remediation: Scope queries and project only required columns for each use case.

controls.title: Accuracy and correction technical path
controls.explanation: No correction/update path signals observed.
limitations: Downstream processor propagation not fully visible
controls.remediation: Implement authenticated correction flows and cascade updates to processors.

controls.title: PII in application logs
controls.explanation: Unsanitized personal-data logging signals detected.
limitations: Dynamic log payloads may evade static detection
controls.remediation: Redact or structure-log with allowlists; never log raw identifiers.

controls.title: PII in LLM prompts or embeddings
controls.explanation: Personal data appears in LLM prompt/embedding paths.
limitations: Runtime prompt assembly may be indirect
controls.remediation: Minimise/redact PII before model calls; document processor terms for AI vendors.

controls.title: PII in URLs or query strings
controls.explanation: No query-string personal-data signals observed.
limitations: Server logs of URLs may still capture PII even if code is fixed later
controls.remediation: Move identifiers into authenticated request bodies or opaque tokens.

controls.title: Browser storage of personal data
controls.explanation: No browser-storage personal-data signals observed.
limitations: HttpOnly cookie policy requires runtime/config review
controls.remediation: Avoid storing raw PII in browser storage; prefer short-lived opaque session tokens.

controls.title: Insecure HTTP transmission of personal data
controls.explanation: No cleartext HTTP personal-data transport signals observed.
limitations: TLS termination outside repo is not visible
controls.remediation: Use HTTPS for all personal-data transport; enforce HSTS where applicable.

controls.title: Authentication on personal-data routes
controls.explanation: No missing-auth route signals observed; global guards may still apply.
limitations: Framework-global auth guards may be invisible to local patterns
controls.remediation: Apply authentication and authorisation middleware to all personal-data endpoints.

controls.title: Hardcoded production personal data or sensitive fixtures
controls.explanation: High-confidence personal data values (literals) appear embedded in source or fixtures.
limitations: Synthetic test data may look real
controls.remediation: Replace with clearly synthetic fixtures; never commit production personal data.

controls.title: Debug endpoints exposing personal records
controls.explanation: No debug personal-data exposure signals observed.
limitations: Environment gating may not be visible statically
controls.remediation: Remove or strictly gate debug endpoints; never expose personal dumps in production.

controls.title: Weak or reversible masking of identifiers
controls.explanation: No weak masking patterns observed.
limitations: Context-specific display masking may be acceptable
controls.remediation: Use irreversible hashing or strong partial masking for logs and non-essential displays.

controls.title: Missing audit signals on sensitive personal-data operations
controls.explanation: No missing-audit signals observed.
limitations: External SIEM integration may not appear in app code
controls.remediation: Emit immutable audit events for access, export, correction, deletion, and admin overrides.

controls.title: Personal-data breach preparedness signals
controls.explanation: No breach/incident technical signals observed.
limitations: Operational readiness cannot be proven from code alone
controls.remediation: Implement breach detection hooks and documented notification workflows.

controls.title: Retention or TTL mechanism for personal data stores
controls.explanation: No retention mechanism evaluation inputs found.
limitations: Policy periods vs technical TTL need human alignment
controls.remediation: Add retention fields and scheduled deletion jobs matching purpose-limited periods.

controls.title: Erasure / account deletion path
controls.explanation: Erasure path signals found; backup/processor cascade needs review.
limitations: Backups and processor erasure lag may be invisible
controls.remediation: Implement verified erasure including backups/processors within stated timelines.
controls.humanReviewQuestion: How are backups and processor copies erased after a request?

controls.title: Retained personal data without visible deletion path
controls.explanation: No personal-data stores observed.
limitations: External data warehouses may hold copies

controls.title: Data Principal access / export endpoint
controls.explanation: No data access/export endpoint signals observed.
limitations: Completeness of export packages needs review
controls.remediation: Provide authenticated access/export of personal data held by the fiduciary.

controls.title: Correction request implementation
controls.explanation: No correction/update path signals observed.
limitations: Operational SLAs not visible in code
controls.remediation: Expose correction request APIs with tracking and authentication.

controls.title: Grievance handling technical signal
controls.explanation: No grievance/privacy-contact technical signals observed.
limitations: Effectiveness of redressal is operational
controls.remediation: Publish grievance contact and implement tracked grievance intake.

controls.title: Nomination-related implementation signal
controls.explanation: No nomination implementation signals observed.
limitations: Applicability depends on product context
controls.remediation: Where relevant, support nominee registration and authenticated exercise of rights.

controls.title: Children's data processing signals
controls.explanation: Children's data / age signals observed; verification strength needs review.
limitations: Age verification strength requires specialised review
controls.remediation: Implement verifiable age assurance and restrict tracking/ads for children as required.
controls.humanReviewQuestion: Does the service knowingly process children's personal data?

controls.title: Guardian / parental consent flow
controls.explanation: Children's data signals present without guardian/parental consent implementation signals.
limitations: Identity of guardian cannot be proven statically
controls.remediation: Implement verifiable parental/guardian consent before processing children's data.

controls.title: External processors and recipients inventory
controls.explanation: Observed 30 external recipient/processor technical signal(s).
limitations: Contracts and DPAs are not in code

controls.title: Cross-border or external-service technical signals
controls.explanation: External services present; transfer geography not fully determined from code.
limitations: Actual transfer location depends on vendor routing
controls.remediation: Document transfer destinations and align with permitted geographies / conditions.
controls.humanReviewQuestion: Which jurisdictions receive personal data in production?

controls.title: Significant Data Fiduciary technical obligations
controls.explanation: Significant Data Fiduciary status is unknown; cannot verify Section 10 technical obligations from code alone.
limitations: SDF designation is organisational/legal, not inferred solely from code
controls.remediation: If designated SDF, implement DPO, audits, and DPIA processes with technical evidence trails.
controls.humanReviewQuestion: Has the organisation been notified/designated as a Significant Data Fiduciary?

controls.title: Rights request authentication and tracking
controls.explanation: Rights endpoints found without request tracking signals.
limitations: Identity proofing strength needs human review
controls.remediation: Authenticate requesters and track request lifecycle to completion.
controls.humanReviewQuestion: How is Data Principal identity verified for rights requests?

controls.title: Unprotected personal-data exports
controls.explanation: No export endpoints observed.
limitations: Gateway-level auth may be external

controls.title: Notice and consent adequacy (human review)
controls.explanation: Does notice describe purposes, rights, and grievance contact clearly?
limitations: Outside deterministic scope
controls.remediation: Commission product/legal review of notices and consent UX.
controls.humanReviewQuestion: Does notice describe purposes, rights, and grievance contact clearly?

controls.title: Processor contracts and instructions (human review)
controls.explanation: External processors observed; processor contracts are not established from code (declared evidence required).
limitations: Contracts are not executable evidence
controls.remediation: Attach processor contract references as declared evidence; never treat as deterministic pass.
controls.humanReviewQuestion: Do contracts bind processors to fiduciary instructions and security?

controls.title: Whole user objects sent to third parties
controls.explanation: No whole-user third-party shipment patterns observed.
limitations: SDK auto-PII collection may be config-driven
controls.remediation: Send only necessary attributes; scrub PII before third-party calls.
